description.content: Publish, query, update, delete, and download workbooks. Workbooks contain one or more views (sheets, dashboards, or stories) and can connect to one or more data sources.
Returns the workbooks on a site. If the user is not an administrator, the method returns just the workbooks that the user has permissions to view.

query.description: The number of items to return in one response. The minimum is 1 and the maximum is 1000.
The page number of the set of items to return. The default is 1.
An expression that lets you specify a subset of items to return. Use the format filter=field:operator:value. Operators include eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, has, and in.
An expression that lets you specify the order in which items are returned. Use the format sort=field:direction where direction is asc or desc.
An expression that lets you specify which fields are included in the response. Use the format fields=field1,field2. Use _default_ to return the default set of fields, or _all_ to return all fields.
